notes: Two-column 1877 parliament minutes where the line geometry is broken throughout: many crops cut the text line in half vertically (1, 7, 8, 20, 40 show only the lower or upper half of the letters), many crops span both columns across the gutter with joined labels (2, 4, 11-13, 21-28, 32-37), and many labels do not match their crop at all (3, 10, 14, 17, 29, 30, 31, 38, 39 show other text). Only a few lines (5, 6, 9, 15, 18, 19) are clean, too few to salvage by pattern.
